title: Design and Implementation of a Predictive Financial Decision Support Platform
tldr: A Flask-based financial decision support platform integrating LSTM, Linear Regression, and ARIMA models with a recommendation engine to predict savings growth, monthly expenditure, and savings rate, achieving up to 93% prediction accuracy.
problem_and_motivation: Individuals frequently make financial decisions without quantifying long-term consequences, relying on intuition rather than structured prediction. Existing financial tools often require manual input and do not combine multiple forecasting models with actionable guidance. There is a lack of integrated platforms that combine predictive analytics with rule-based recommendations to transform financial planning from manual estimation to data-driven decision-making.
approach: Developed a Flask-based web platform integrating three prediction models: LSTM, Linear Regression, and ARIMA.
Implemented a recommendation engine using rule-based logic triggered by predicted savings rate thresholds.
Engineered features from transactional data including transaction type, amount, and temporal context.
Applied label encoding and one-hot encoding for categorical features, min-max scaling for numerical inputs.
Defined composite savings rate as the ratio of total savings to total income.
Conducted model evaluation using MAE, MSE, RMSE, and accuracy scores.
Implemented backtesting to evaluate model performance on historical data.
Designed user interface for transaction entry, prediction visualization, and recommendation display.
findings: LSTM achieves highest accuracy for savings growth prediction (93%) by capturing long-term sequential patterns.
Linear Regression achieves highest accuracy for monthly expenditure prediction (87%).
ARIMA achieves highest accuracy for savings rate prediction (84%) using rolling window analysis.
Composite savings rate metric provides more meaningful financial guidance than individual income or savings values.
Rule-based recommendations triggered by savings rate thresholds provide actionable financial advice.
Feature engineering significantly improves prediction accuracy for all three models.
Combined model approach outperforms single-model systems for multi-dimensional financial forecasting.
key_figures_tables: Figure 1: System Architecture → Shows three-layer architecture: user interface, business logic, and model training.
Figure 2: Savings Growth Over Next 12 Months → LSTM prediction showing gradual savings increase trajectory.
Figure 3: Monthly Expenditure Forecast → Linear Regression projection of spending patterns.
Figure 4: Savings Rate Projection → ARIMA prediction showing 80% accuracy across test instances.
Table 1: Accuracy Comparison Across Models → LSTM 93% (savings), LR 87% (expenditure), ARIMA 84% (savings rate).

definitions.definition: Long Short-Term Memory, a recurrent neural network architecture with gating mechanisms for long-term dependency modeling in financial sequences.
AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average, a statistical time-series model for financial forecasting using rolling windows.
The ratio of total savings to total income, providing context-aware measure of financial health.
A combined measure that integrates multiple financial indicators to provide more meaningful guidance.
A system that applies predefined if-then rules to trigger recommendations based on predicted financial thresholds.
Evaluating model performance by applying it to historical data to assess predictive accuracy.
A lightweight Python web framework used for building the platform's web interface and API endpoints.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: This paper contributes an integrated financial decision support platform that combines three complementary prediction models (LSTM, Linear Regression, ARIMA) with a rule-based recommendation engine, demonstrating that multi-model approaches outperform single-model systems for financial forecasting. It introduces the composite savings rate metric that provides more meaningful financial guidance than absolute values, and validates the approach with up to 93% prediction accuracy across three financial dimensions.
directly_justifies: LSTM achieves 93% accuracy for savings growth prediction by capturing long-term sequential patterns.
Composite savings rate provides more meaningful financial guidance than absolute income or savings values.
Multi-model integration outperforms single-model systems for multi-dimensional financial forecasting.
Rule-based recommendations triggered by predicted thresholds provide actionable financial advice.
Feature engineering significantly improves prediction accuracy across all models.
limits: Rule-based recommendations lack adaptability to individual user contexts beyond threshold triggers.
Evaluation on limited historical data without out-of-sample validation.
No comparison against commercial financial planning tools or user studies.
Platform does not account for irregular income patterns or multiple income sources.
topic_relevance.topic_mapping_rationale: The paper was systematically scanned across all 14 topic domains. Domain 6 (Predictive Modeling) received high relevance as the core contribution is multi-model financial forecasting. Domain 7 (Budgeting) received high relevance for savings rate and expenditure prediction. Domain 11 (Recommendations) received high relevance for the rule-based recommendation engine. Domain 4 (Existing Systems) received medium relevance for contextualizing existing tools. Domains 1-3, 5, 8-10, 12, and 14 were considered and rejected as the paper does not address Filipino demographics, financial data APIs, expense categorization, behavioral profiles, anomaly detection, privacy, engagement, or synthetic data generation.

limitations: Limited to historical data without out-of-sample validation.
No user study or comparison with commercial tools.
Rule-based recommendations lack personalization beyond threshold triggers.
Does not handle irregular income or multiple income sources.
